changes: Rename integration module to triha_cpu.
Conditionally instantiate EX1 only when SUPPORT_DUAL_ISSUE is true; otherwise tie its outputs to zero.
Keep original issue, CSR, exception and memory control connections.
Connect maintained frontend and select registered redirect independently of outer MMU.
Connect maintained issue module with payload selection independent of kill/exception controls.
Connect maintained multiplier/CSR data-register derivatives.
Select predictor training register independently from redirect timing.
Connect independent load bypass payload from maintained LSU to both pipeline controllers.
Connect the existing divider through an optional full-tuple input register; default adds one cycle only to divider completion, while legacy cycle miter disables it.
Connect cycle-equivalent maintained execution unit with independent PC-result addition.

changes: Rename integration module to triha_frontend.
Select existing fetch registered-redirect branch when REGISTER_REDIRECT is enabled; outer MMU remains controlled only by SUPPORT_MMU.
Register complete 70-bit training event one cycle before predictor update, including taken/not-taken events without a miss request.
Connect the maintained decode/FIFO derivative with free-slot wide payload capture and preserved raw CSR history.
Connect the equivalent parallel-priority prediction-table derivative; prediction/training cycles and table sizes remain unchanged.

changes: Select raw payload/class lane from registered expected-PC bit 2 using the existing aligned fetch-FIFO contract; retain full PC/valid matching on issue and accept.
Rename integration module to triha_issue.
Select CSR invalid-instruction payload flag independently of late kill controls; CSR side-effect enable unchanged.
Choose scheduling class and prospective eligibility without late cancellation; apply original squash/CSR cancellation to final fire/accept strobes.
Keep original IRQ inhibit classification on cancellation cycles.
Pass independent load bypass payload to both pipeline controllers, retaining original completion/fault payload.
Connect the maintained register-file wrapper: native zero-latency distributed RAM for single issue; existing generic implementation for dual issue.
Use the registered E2/WB tags only for operand data selection; preserve all original commit/RF/scoreboard tags and assert equality on actual issue.

Compute PC+4 before late redirect selection using ADS-documented syn_keep; generate kept PC+8 only for dual issue, avoiding unused single-issue hardware; identical PC priority, arithmetic and cycle behavior.

changes: Rename integration module to triha_csr.
Separate wide CSR data registers from late opcode valid, retaining original valid, exception, read-side-effect and commit-write controls.

changes: Rename integration/helper modules to triha_lsu/triha_lsu_fifo.
Export pure load payload for bypass without response ack/error selection; preserve the original completion/fault address bus and all request/exception controls.
Decode address format and store data without late issue valid; retain final request/unaligned strobe qualification.
Keep address/data/cacheability payload in separate registers with response-wait and unaccepted-request holds, excluding late fault cancellation from wide data.

For the existing depth-two request FIFO, rotate the original two storage banks into registered head/tail coordinates; preserve accept/pop/count and all stale output data with no extra latency or payload state. Other depths retain the original implementation.

Forwarding payload selection uses registered E2 valid rather than stall-gated valid; destination tag and all commit/stall enables retain original gating.
Export separate E2/WB data-bypass destination tags using registered valid/rd-valid/opcode only; original stall-qualified commit/hazard tags remain unchanged.

changes: Register the complete 144-bit divider input tuple and one valid bit, sampling payload independently of validity.

changes: Rename integration decode/FIFO modules without changing original vendor bytes.
Sample wide PC/instruction data only into the free write slot whenever not full, independently of push/flush; original count/pointers/valid/fault metadata control unchanged.
Preserve original invalid-slot CSR classification using one historical static CSR bit per word/entry, captured only on original non-flushed pushes and derived by the original decoder.

changes: Rename integration predictor and its unchanged local LFSR helper.
Select exact-PC and upper-word matches with highest-index one-hot masks; parallel bitwise AND/OR data selection preserves duplicate tags and original if/X comparison behavior.
Write each BTB entry directly using its highest-priority one-hot hit or the original miss-allocation index; BHT/RAS/training/LFSR state and cycles unchanged.
Adapt the fixed OpenTitan one-hot mux to flat Verilog ports; no additional compiler or runtime dependency.
Localize each BHT entry saturation transition after its address match, preserving counter/reset/condition priority and all cycles while avoiding a dynamic write-side counter read.

Compute exact-PC and upper-word highest-index priority masks in parallel before selecting the existing fallback; preserve original procedural if/X handling and all state/cycles. Keep the parallel masks as synthesis boundaries.

Share the 29 high tag bits between exact-PC and upper-word lookups; use kept three-bit equality groups for the complete query and write tags, preserving all 32 bits and procedural if/X semantics without state or cycle changes.

Extend lookup sharing to every bit except bit two, retaining low alignment bits; decode RAS actual/speculative write indices per entry before late prediction enables, preserving original confirmed-return/speculative-call overlap priority and all state/cycles.
